title: Tencent Yuanqi Platform Officially Ceases Service Today: Data Export Available Until January 2027

content_html:
Tencent Yuanqi Platform officially ceased service today. All public-facing services, including app access, data read/write, API calls, and console use, have been fully shut down. Agents published through the platform to channels such as Official Accounts, Service Accounts, and WeChat Customer Service have also stopped responding.

Previously, on the 29th of last month, Tencent Yuanqi stopped allowing the creation of new agents and the distribution of API Keys. Currently, users can submit export requests through the data export console. Requests will be accepted until January 9, 2027. Except for logs legally required to be retained, the company will completely delete all user data after the deadline.

In addition, if users purchased resource packages through the old entry point on the Tencent Cloud official website and still have a balance, they can apply for a refund. The company also recommends Tencent Cloud Agent Development Platform (ADP) and Official Account Smart Reply as alternatives.

It is reported that Tencent Yuanqi was launched in May 2024 and once served as a one-stop agent creation and distribution platform, integrating an agent store, low-threshold creation tools, multimodal plugins, and omnichannel distribution channels. The shutdown of the platform marks a phased conclusion and strategic contraction of Tencent's agent infrastructure layout. In the future, industry competition will accelerate toward higher-level platforms with stronger ecosystem integration capabilities and cloud collaboration.
